name: Diagram gestures
responsibility: Turns a press, a drag, a two-finger pinch and a click into a pan, a zoom, a pick or an open
description: A press within the pick tolerance selects what it landed on. A drag pans immediately and stops where released. A second touch pointer hands the gesture to useTouchPinch, which calls the camera controller with both fingers before and after each move. A press stops an eased move already under way.

outgoing.label: pan immediately, and delegate touch pinch
outgoing.description: useDiagramGestures calls camera.panBy; its useTouchPinch helper calls camera.pinch for two touch pointers.
